map.翼载荷高好还是低好？: Is high or low wing loading better?
map.低翼载荷（大翼面积）失速速度低、机动/起降性能好，但诱阻大、结构重；高翼载荷巡航: Low wing loading (large area) gives lower stall speed and better maneuver/takeoff-landing, but higher induced drag and heavier structure; high loading cruises efficiently but needs longer takeoff/landing. Balance by mission (low for fighters, high for bombers).
map.翼载荷用重量还是质量？: Use weight or mass for wing loading?
map.航空常用 W/S（力/面积，N/m²），因直接关联升力=重量平衡。若用质量/面积: Aviation typically uses W/S (force/area, N/m²) because it directly ties to lift = weight balance. If using mass/area (kg/m²), multiply by g—keep units consistent.
